query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL public.orders и сохраняй их в JSON-файл orders_export.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: pg_orders_to_json_export
  name: PostgreSQL Orders to JSON Export
  description: Periodically extracts new records from PostgreSQL public.orders and
    saves them to orders_export.json
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 1 hour
sources:
- id: source_postgres
  name: Read PostgreSQL Orders
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.orders
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DATABASE_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_incremental
  name: Extract New Records
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: updated_at > {{LAST_RUN_TIMESTAMP}}
    mode: incremental
sinks:
- id: sink_json_file
  name: Write to JSON File
  type: File
  location: orders_export.json
  connection:
    properties:
      format: json
      mode: overwrite
processed_data:
- id: orders_json_data
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_postgres
  to_id: process_incremental
  data_ref: orders_json_data
- from_id: process_incremental
  to_id: sink_json_file
  data_ref: orders_json_data
